sessions.topic: Cascade Ridge race weekend recap and summer planning

turns.message: evening crew. cascade ridge recap. 9 racers, all finished, no injuries. greg and i shuttled cleanly, ana and bernard handled the welcome desk. cyrus and sonia put on a hell of a dinner. proud of the whole crew.
PERSONAL BEST 🔥🔥🔥 south rim under 4 hours. dropped the strava link in the side group
i finished and my legs are ruined and i loved every second of it ☀️🌲
good weekend. tired
the dinner was MAGIC y'all 🥂🍷 cyrus outdid himself, the lamb braise was unreal, and we had 19 people at the table at one point. that's the dream. i live for this 🍷✨

Team, it was an honor to plate for the crew. The lamb braise was the simplest thing on the menu and it carried the table. One does not ever fail to be moved by a long table after a long day in the mountains.

Friends, the night sky after dinner was extraordinary; Iris, did you see the moon-rise over the south rim? I was on a quiet walk back from the cabin with Beatrix and we both stopped to watch it for a quarter hour. Friends, this is what I joined for; the running is, in many ways, an excuse for the rest of this. Anyway: I hope a few of you will come along to the next dark-sky outing, those night walks remain my favorite kind of group time.
